description: Finds YouTube channels suitable for brand sponsorships using apidojo's YouTube scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: find YouTube channels to sponsor, discover YouTubers who accept brand deals in a niche, identify YouTube influencers for mid-roll or integration sponsorships, find channels that already run sponsors in a product category, research YouTube sponsorship opportunities for a brand, identify high-CPM YouTube audiences for B2B or SaaS sponsorships, or build a YouTube outreach list for a sponsorship campaign. Returns channel name, subscriber count, avg views, engagement rate, niche, and sponsorship history. Ideal for brand partnerships managers, SaaS marketing teams, and sponsorship agencies.
